findings.resolution: Code now advances profile elapsed by now-request.now_stamp while preserving absolute execution boundary.

findings.resolution: Same-source node_parameter_defaults helper materializes full IMM parameters and actual prediction topic.

findings.resolution: Re-read current restored files; verified ROS wire identity, elapsed reference phase, model_from_parameters, prefix endpoint/subset mapping and recording environment on current bytes.
findings.evidence: imm/root_review_source_drift.json retains detected old drift; imm/36_current_root_integration_review.log records 47 passing current tests.

checked_invariants: Mutually exclusive primary BCTRA/IMM launch; BCTRA ordinary default; shadow has separate prediction topic.
Tracker remains unique PX4 publisher; P6 adds no competing yaw/control authority.
Original nominal whole-sphere FOV, sea, dynamic bounds, source acquisition freshness and leases remain required.
Calibration bytes SHA, family and policy are receiver-owned and included in enabled constraint fingerprints.
Latest prediction revalidation carries covariance/conditionals and does not refresh raw navigation or observation epochs.
Strict uncertainty failure rejects; nominal fallback is explicit and cannot override original nominal FOV failure.
Readiness binds case/config/source fingerprints and requires actual prior healthy pilot before later experiment roles.
Full P6 raw/forecast/conditional and graph evidence is enabled by the protocol environment.
Risk horizon accepts full window (0) or exact .45 second lease; missing prefix endpoint fails explicitly.
Prefix risk reports original subset indices and never labels unchecked suffix robust; full-curve nominal hard checks remain.
Remaining receiver lease ends at min(curve.end, curve.start+.45); latest prediction does not renew that deadline.
Current-speed USV prior and CTRA algorithm evidence are separate reviewer-owned math work, not self-approved by this integration review.
p5_run original_follow_settling now records actual overlay thresholds including relative_speed_enter; this metadata repair does not change controller thresholds.
limitations: Review scope is root integration and exact source bytes; no self-review approval of reviewer-owned IMM algorithm.
Historical stopped-CTRA failures remain in prediction_02 and prediction_03; corrected stop Q and conservative posterior priors were frozen for prediction_04, never erased or relabelled.
Synthetic empirical envelopes provide engineering coverage only, with no real-world 95percent or joint/continuous-time probability guarantee.
IMM primary and robust strict require their separate actual shadow/robust gates; this review grants no such flight success.
Actual DDS/Gazebo CPU contention, RGB-D residuals and yaw/attitude/extrinsic errors require isolated pilot evidence.
Integrated consumers expect default /planning/imm_diagnostics unless producer and consumers are coherently remapped.
Any reviewed runtime source fingerprint change invalidates this exact snapshot; new evidence and qualification directory required.
